methodologyNotes: Self-serve USD pricing for leading PDF-tool vendors collected on 2026-06-14. Several official pricing pages either timed out (adobe.com/acrobat/pricing), returned 404 (foxit.com, gonitro.com/pricing), failed TLS verification (pdf.foxit.com), or geolocated to EUR rather than USD (ilovepdf.com, sejda.com, pdfexpert.com); for those vendors USD figures were taken from reputable 2026 pricing-comparison pages (Capterra, G2, Xodo, Tekpon, costbench, aiproductivity.ai, toolradar) and each such fallback is stated in that vendor's provenance, with a second independent corroboration URL added wherever possible. monthlyUsd is the recurring monthly cost for the smallest billable unit; where a vendor publishes only an annualized monthly rate the month-to-month rate is noted and annualDiscountPct is set when both figures are published, else null. Per-user/per-seat tiers are billingModel per_seat with the per-user price recorded; fixed single-account tiers are flat; usage-metered or quote-only tiers with no flat rate are custom. Quote-only / contact-sales tiers have monthlyUsd null (never guessed). minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin and overagePerCall are null on every plan because they do not apply to PDF software. hipaa/baa are set true/false only where explicitly stated, else null; PDF editors generally do not advertise HIPAA/BAA so most are null.
